story.label: My story
story.title: My path to yoga
story.subtitle: A practice that began as a personal search and became my way of supporting others.

discover.label: The beginning
discover.title: How I discovered yoga
discover.text: I came to yoga at a time when I needed to pause. I wasn’t looking to perfect poses — I was looking for a space to breathe, listen inward and return to my body with kindness.

train.label: The decision
train.title: When I chose to train
train.text: The more I practised, the clearer it became: I wanted to go deeper. I decided to train seriously to understand not only movement, but also breath, anatomy and the mindful dimension of yoga.

change.label: The shift
change.title: What changed in my life
change.text: Yoga taught me to inhabit myself with more presence. It softened my relationship with stress, restored confidence and reminded me that wellbeing is not a destination — it is a daily practice.

teach.label: Sharing
teach.title: Why I teach
teach.text: I teach because I want others to find what I found: a warm yoga practice without pressure, with space to simply be. Helping you come back to yourself is how this path makes sense to me.

philosophy.label: My approach
philosophy.title: How I teach
philosophy.subtitle: What you’ll find in my classes: presence, care and yoga that adapts to you.

accessible.title: Accessible yoga, no pressure
accessible.text: It isn’t about going further — it’s about coming home to yourself. We practise with respect, without competing or forcing.

breath.title: Attention to breath and body
breath.text: Breath guides movement. I invite you to feel, observe and choose from inner listening.

levels.title: Adaptations for all levels
levels.text: Every body is different. I offer variations and options so you can practise safely, wherever you start.

safe.title: A safe, judgement-free space
safe.text: I create warm spaces where you can be yourself. There is no performance here — only presence, care and community.

training.label: Credentials
training.title: Training & certifications
training.subtitle: A solid foundation to guide you with care, clarity and awareness.

main.label: Main training
main.title: RYT 220H · India
main.text: Certified RYT 220H training in India, where I deepened asana, pranayama, philosophy and the essence of mindful practice.

extra.label: Ongoing learning
extra.title: Courses & specialisation
extra.text: I continue training in Yin Yoga, applied anatomy, meditation and supportive tools to adapt practice to every stage of life.

retreats.label: Immersions
retreats.title: Retreats & study
retreats.text: Retreats and immersions have shaped how I teach: more presence, deeper listening and a more human approach to yoga.

faq.label: Common questions
faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: The essentials so you can choose calmly and start when you’re ready.

beginner.question: Can I come if I’ve never practised yoga?
beginner.answer: Yes. Classes are open to all levels and I offer adaptations so you can practise safely, even if it’s your first time. If you’re unsure, message me and I’ll guide you.

pack.question: How does the 8-class pack work?
pack.answer: The pack gives you 8 group classes per month, including Sunday beach yoga. You can mix styles according to what your body needs each week. No commitment.

cancel.question: What if I can’t attend a booked class?
cancel.answer: Please let me know as early as possible on WhatsApp. That way I can free your spot and, when the plan allows, move you to another class in the week. I’m happy to find the best option with you.
